unsupported: The business began with a focus on challenge coins and patches for military and public‑safety organizations and has since expanded into a broad catalog of branded merchandise.

The company produces challenge coins (die‑struck, 3D, enamel), patches (embroidered, PVC, woven, leather, chenille, sublimated), enamel pins (hard/soft enamel, cloisonné, die‑struck), custom hats (Richardson, flexfit, snapback with embroidery or patch application), race medals, metal emblems, keychains, ornaments, charms, and a range of promotional items.
Decoration processes include die striking, enamel filling, embroidery, PVC molding, laser etching, and sublimation.
